entry.title: A historic first | Audi R26 show car × amfAR London 2026​

media:group.media:title: A historic first | Audi R26 show car × amfAR London 2026​
media:group.media:description:
From the streets to the racetrack. And beyond.​
For the first time ever, an Audi R26 show car will be available to a private collector at amfAR London 2026. The experience continues at the 2027 Spanish Grand Prix in Madrid, with two Paddock Club passes for race day and the opportunity to meet Audi Revolut F1® Team drivers Nico Hülkenberg and Gabriel Bortoleto, who will personally hand over the car, complete with a driver’s signature. Together, accelerating progress.​
Discover the auction via the link in our bio.
#Audi #amfAR #Formula1 #AcceleratingProgress #VorsprungDurchTechnik​ ----- The vehicle shown is the Audi R26 show car.​
